covered: required word/document.xml token stream with exactly one direct w:body, at most one terminal body-level w:sectPr, and ancestry-aware direct w:body/w:sectPr or w:body/w:p/w:pPr/w:sectPr binding inventory
optional word/footnotes.xml and word/endnotes.xml token streams
direct explicit first/default/even w:headerReference and w:footerReference slots aligned by section ordinal, kind, and role
selected Transitional w:hdr and w:ftr token streams deduplicated by the complete three-side physical key
outOfScope: inherited or omitted header/footer role semantics
unselected header/footer parts and unselected relationship semantics
complete OPC, content-type, relationship-graph, XML Schema, pagination, rendering, and field-evaluation validation

acceptedXmlSubset: Transitional WordprocessingML, office-document relationships, and package relationships namespaces only
UTF-8 with at most one leading BOM and an optional XML 1.0 UTF-8 declaration
one expanded-name root, valid namespace-scoped QNames, and no duplicate expanded attributes
predefined and numeric XML references only; comments, non-declaration processing instructions, CDATA, and DTDs reject

packagePolicy: Lean constructs a bounded binary classic single-disk ZIP central/local index before extraction
ZIP64, encryption, data descriptors, unsupported methods or flag bits, ambiguous names, duplicate names, unsafe paths, and overlapping local spans reject as not_run
ZIP directory records are rejected during binary indexing; only regular file entries enter the trusted inventory
unzip -p -- is invoked only for one exact indexed safe name; output length and CRC-32 must match the binary index
checkedProperties: The required main story must extract, decode, parse, tokenize, and produce a bounded selector inventory on all three sides before any v4 response exists.
Main inventory rejects missing, nested, or multiple direct bodies and duplicate or non-terminal body-level terminal sectPr; out-of-section header/footer references are structured issues.
Fixed main, footnote, and endnote stories retain the generic six-check collection behavior.
Every per-side supported direct binding identity has exactly one identifying issue or membership in exactly one ordinally aligned logical slot, mutually exclusively.
Every successful slot maps to exactly one physical story and each story locator list equals the canonical ordered list derived from aligned slots.
Each checked relationship triple matches its loaded physical key, generated name, and exact original/revised/combined token lists.
A selected-part load failure retains every successfully loaded physical story and its contiguously reindexed selecting slots.

Required main is processed first; complete relationship selected-target metadata and work precede footnotes and endnotes; metadata-known crossings prevent decompression, and aggregate XML-event exhaustion stops later work.

Bounded XML failures carry typed reasons and consumption counts; event-limit failure when remaining aggregate allowance is less than or equal to 500,000 is aggregate exhaustion, while larger remaining allowance preserves per-part classification.
All fixed and successfully selected stories are checked through story_collection_checker_sound.
Section count or ordered direct-slot differences fail closed without claiming semantic section identity.
Public certificate protocol v1 remains additive; internal protocol v4 evidence is present together only for valid passed or failed runs.

ecma376Traceability.claim: The selector recognizes direct typed Transitional w:headerReference bindings.
The selector recognizes direct typed Transitional w:footerReference bindings.
A selected header target must have a Transitional w:hdr root.
A selected footer target must have a Transitional w:ftr root.

knownUncheckedAreas: rendering, pagination, inherited roles, and semantic section identity
unselected parts and complete relationship/content-type integrity
field instruction evaluation, cached results, and bookmark resolution
general XML canonicalization outside the accepted subset
